## Source
- ColorLib: Genius (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/genius/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/genius/

## Section order
1. Navbar (logo "Genius University", nav, "Apply Now!" CTA)
2. Hero (bg image, heading about education, 2 CTAs)
3. Search Course (search bar, "I want to study")
4. Info Cards (Workshop, Admission, Notice Board, Library)
5. About/Stats (leading schools description)
6. Counters (4 stats, light bg)
7. Testimonials (student quotes carousel)
8. Advisors (instructor profiles, circular avatars)
9. Free Trial CTA ("Try our free trial course")
10. Courses (3 cards: English, Computer Eng, Business Studies)
11. Blog (3 recent posts)
12. Events (latest events)
13. Newsletter Parallax (subscribe form)
14. Footer (branding, columns, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #167ce9 (blue) | Secondary: #ffc300 (gold)
- Accent: #78d5ef (cyan) | Dark: #1b212c
- Fonts: Work Sans (headings), Roboto (body)
- Buttons: 30px radius | Cards: 4px | Avatars: 50%
